title: A Space Expert Hoped to Use the Eclipse as Science Class. The D.J.s Had Other Plans.
summary: Mar Carretero-Castrillo, an astrophysicist, returned to her remote village in Spain to be in the path of totality. Hundreds of partygoers came too.
